name: ubuntu/systemd-service
title: User service and timer
summary: User service and timer (systemd --user) that run a program at login or on a schedule.
when: Use when something has to run at login or every day or hour without a terminal open.

name.about: Unit name, used for the .service and .timer file names and by systemctl.

command.about: Command the service runs: absolute path and arguments.

schedule.about: systemd calendar expression for the timer (daily, hourly, *-*-* 03:30:00).

next: Write every file under files/ into the user's project, set command and schedule to what the user needs, run ./install.sh and follow the systemctl lines it prints.
